Expert insights beyond the data. From routine to complex challenges.

Delivering testing confidence when the stakes are highest.

I'm trying to...

Element is a global provider of lab-based Testing, Inspection and Certification services, powering confident decisions in the most highly-regulated industries.

Element’s expertise cover a diverse range of materials and products - in sectors where failure in service is simply not an option. From concept through ongoing compliance, we support your entire product life cycle. Whether you need standardized high-volume testing or solutions for one-of-a-kind challenges, our experts become genuine partners in your success. We combine responsive service and clear communication with unwavering accuracy to help you launch safer products with confidence.

Unlocking global market access requirements

Some of the many regulatory and industry certification requirements we help you meet.

Material Testing

Element is one of the largest independent providers of destructive and non-destructive testing services for metals and non-metals. We help to make certain these materials are safe, quality, compliant and fit for purpose.

Read more

Product Testing

Element is a leading provider of product compliance and qualification testing services to its customers in the world’s most highly regulated industries.

Read more

Certification

Element certifies products and management systems to help make certain that they are compliant to all relevant international standards. 

Read more

News

Element Announces Strategic Acquisition of CETECOM Inc.

Element acquires CETECOM Inc., expanding US Connected Technology testing capacity. Deal adds further wireless, automotive & IoT certification services to Element's global portfolio.

Dec 8, 2025

Element Materials Technology Joins The Manufacturing Technology Centre (MTC)

Element Materials Technology has joined the Manufacturing Technology Centre (MTC) as a Tier 2 member, reinforcing its commitment to innovation, sustainability, and technical excellence in UK manufacturing. Through this partnership, Element will collaborate on advanced engineering, digital transformation, and research initiatives to accelerate industrial progress.

Oct 16, 2025

Element Becomes First UK Testing Laboratory to Achieve ASCA Accreditation

Element Materials Technology, a global leader in laboratory-based testing services, has become the first testing provider in the UK to be accredited under the U.S. Food and Drug Administration’s (FDA) Accreditation Scheme for Conformity Assessment (ASCA).

Oct 9, 2025

Element Materials Technology Receives International Accreditation for Cyber Security Testing of Products

Element Materials Technology has achieved ISO 17025 accreditation for cyber security product testing at its Hull laboratory. This milestone strengthens Element’s leadership in digital safety and supports global manufacturers in meeting EU Radio Equipment Directive (RED) compliance requirements.

Oct 6, 2025
